privacy.download: It is downloaded the first time and kept in this browser.
footer.local: Everything is processed in your browser and your files do not leave your device. What is downloaded is the model, from its Hugging Face repository, and the software that runs it, from this site.
footer.conversion: ONNX weights published by {author} ({license}), downloaded from their Hugging Face repository.
footer.runtimes: Runs on {runtimes}. Part of the code comes from runonweb.ai (MIT).
size.range: Between {min} and {max} MB depending on the browser
status.checking: Checking whether the model is already in this browser…
fallback.wasm: WebGPU failed in this browser; WASM was used instead.
storage.title: Storage
storage.summary: {have} of {count} model files are in this browser. {size} still to download.
storage.complete: The whole model is in this browser.
storage.unknown: The model store could not be checked.
storage.note: The tools only read from the Elffuss model store and cannot delete from it. To free space, empty it from Claw.
result.title: Result
pending: This tool is not ready yet.
error.store-unavailable: The Elffuss model store (models.elffuss.com) cannot be opened. Nothing is downloaded without it.
error.store-permission: The model store does not accept this request.
error.store-quota: It does not fit in this browser's storage. It needs {size}.
error.store-network: The download was cut. Try again: it will resume where it stopped.
error.integrity: The downloaded file is not the expected one. Empty the store from Claw and try again.
error.not-in-registry: Internal error: the requested model is not in the registry.
error.device-unsupported: This model only works with WASM.
error.webgpu-unavailable: This browser does not offer WebGPU.
error.runtime-mismatch: The page did not load completely. Reload it.
error.model-mismatch: The model is not the expected one.
error.decode-failed: The file could not be opened.
error.out-of-memory: This browser cannot give the model the memory it needs. Close other tabs and try again, or try another browser.
error.disposed: The tool was closed. Reload the page.
